div.div: مِيضَأَةٌ , and, sometimes, ↓ مِيضَآءَة , A place in which, and from which, one performs the ablution termed وضوء; (K;) [as also ↓ مُتُوَضَّأٌ :] a مِطْهَرَة (K: in the CK, مَطْهَرَة), meaning that from which, or in which, one performs the said ablution: (TA:) [a tank for ablution, accord. to present usage].
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
